{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_vrtx_01Nj3ngmWrd2ASHTyaSYkCQ8","type":"tool_result","content":"    .ag-filter-apply-panel-button.ag-button {\n      @apply base-button;\n      &[data-ref='applyFilterButton'] {\n        @include button-primary;\n      }\n\n      &[data-ref='resetFilterButton'] {\n        @include button-secondary;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  @apply overflow-x-auto;\n  .ag-header {\n    @apply border-b border-tertiary;\n    .ag-header-cell.align-right {\n      .ag-header-cell-label {\n        @apply justify-end;\n      }\n    }\n    .ag-header-viewport,\n    .ag-pinned-left-header {\n      .ag-floating-filter {\n        input {\n          @include input-field;\n          @apply m-0 p-0 px-2;\n          height: 24px !important;\n        }\n      }\n      // A filter row with no input (see EmptyFloatingFilter): drop the empty body so the button\n      // centres in the cell instead of hanging off its right edge.\n      .ag-floating-filter:has(.ag-grid-filter-button-only) {\n        .ag-floating-filter-body {\n          @apply hidden;\n        }\n\n        .ag-floating-filter-button {\n          @apply flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center;\n          margin: 0;\n        }\n    margin-bottom: 0;\n\n    .tooltip-arrow {\n      transform: rotate(180deg);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n.heat-map-grid {\n  // Keep AG Grid's internal horizontal scroll usable. overflow:visible on the header\n  // viewport breaks scroll sync and clips trailing test-case columns.\n  .ag-theme-balham-dark {\n    overflow-x: hidden;\n  }\n\n  .ag-header-cell.heat-map-test-case-header {\n    padding-left: 0 !important;\n    padding-right: 0 !important;\n\n    .ag-header-cell-comp-wrapper {\n      height: 100%;\n      padding-left: 0;\n      padding-right: 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  .ag-header-cell {\n    border-top: none !important;\n    border-left: none !important;\n    @apply border-r border-b border-tertiary;\n  }\n\n  .ag-cell {\n    border-top: none !important;\n    border-left: none !important;\n    @apply border-r border-b border-tertiary;\n    padding: 0 !important;\n  }\n\n  // The kit wraps the score renderer in a dropdown trigger (`items-center`) and a\n  // content-sized span. With the number hidden, that span collapses to the 1px\n  // border, so the bucket color never fills the row.\n  .ag-cell > .dial-kit-dropdown {\n    align-items: stretch;\n\n    > span {\n      display: flex;\n      height: 100%;\n      min-height: 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  .ag-body-horizontal-scroll {\n    min-height: 12px;\n  }\n}\n\n// GridView wraps the grid in height: 100%. Auto height must follow the rows instead,\n// otherwise the stability heatmap stays inside a fixed viewport and scrolls.\n.heat-map-grid--auto-height {\n  > .size-full {\n    height: auto;\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_vrtx_011Ch1cZKEPmzQXd1ieXBBma","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The header labels in the run results grids now all use one style. I couldn't check this in a browser because the Playwright server failed to connect, so the result hasn't been compared against `mockup.png` on screen. The affected specs pass, including two new tests, and both typechecks are clean. I didn't run the full suite.\n\n**Cause:** the header rows mixed three label styles. Columns with no custom header (Test Case name, Total turns, HTTP, Duration, and Delta in the compare grid) fell back to the UI kit's default: 10px uppercase with wide letter spacing. Some columns used the shared semibold label, and Total requests used it in a different way. Group labels were inconsistent too: Execution and Extracted used the grid's default bold group style, while metric groups like \"DeepEval…\" were regular weight.\n\n**Changes:**\n- **Same style everywhere:** every column and group label in the single-run results grid and the compare grid now uses the shared ellipsis header components (14px semibold, normal case, no extra letter spacing). Group labels were made semibold to match the column labels. Only these run grids use that group component, so no other screen changes.\n- **Alignment:**\n  - Labels over index, total, HTTP, Duration and Delta columns sit at the right edge.\n  - Metric score labels such as SCORE and EXACT_MATCH now always sit at the right. Before, a metric's header only went right when the first row's value was a number, so a missing first value pushed it left even though every value below it sits right. The schema merge in both grids now also skips over missing values when deciding a column's type.\n  - Test Case name, Extracted and Input bindings labels stay on the left.\n- **Letter case:** the `INPUT BINDINGS` group is now `Input bindings`, and its spec expectations were updated.\n- **Spacing:** I didn't change any row heights. The rows were already 40px apart; what looked uneven was the mix of label sizes sitting differently within their rows. One shared label style should fix that, but I haven't seen it on screen.\n- **Spec:** I added a \"Results grid headers share one label style\" requirement to `openspec/specs/run-results-turn-columns/spec.md`.\n\nThe main code changes are in `src/components/Runs/View/utils.ts`, `src/components/Runs/Compare/ExecutionResults/utils/columns.ts` and `src/components/Grid/HeaderComponents/EllipsisHeaderGroup.tsx` (all under `apps/ai-dial-admin`).
